messages.subject: ORDER L-30253
messages.text:
Hi ! 

 

I was between M and L for the measurement and decided to go forward without contacting you. 

I feel the larges are too long for my hand, having about 2cm extra for my fingers and generally feeling loose. 

 
If I pull them the most I can they fit quite OK but as soon as the tightness goes away, they still feel a bit too big. 

 
Maybe the mittens are designed to be that loose ?

 
Let me know if that is the case.

 

 
I have not worn them, just tried them on inside my home for about 30s just to realise they feel a bit too big for my hands.

 

 
Here are my measurements : https://lasclay.com/en/pages/sizing-chart

 
ORANGE LINE : 19 cm

BLUE LINE : 9 cm

 

 
I have no problem paying the cost for shipping, you can send me the bill to pay.

 

 
*** Another option would be that I buy the MEDIUM so I can try both and decide which are best, then ship back one of the two pairs as a RETURN. 

 
Worst case would be that I exchange for the MEDIUM and they are too tight. Let me know if that would be better.

 

 
Thank you,

JF

messages.subject: Re: ORDER L-30253
messages.text:
Hi jeff,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!

messages.subject: Re: ORDER L-30253
messages.text:
Hello Jeff,
 

 Sorry for the longer than usual response time.
 

 The mittens are designed to be relatively snug on your hands, so that you can eventually wear thin gloves underneath, but there shouldn't be more than about 5 millimeters of empty space at your fingertips. Therefore, it is preferable to proceed with exchanging the mittens you received for size M.
 

 Here is the exchange procedure:
 

 PART 1: ON OUR SIDE 
 

 1. We will send you a new pair to the same address as your initial order this week.
 

 2. Included in the envelope will be a return slip, which will allow you to put the first pair of slippers in the same envelope, stick the new slip over the old one, and seal it all up. You can keep the milkweed seeds and the postcard. Please do not use a box, use the same envelope. 
 

 PART 2: ON YOUR SIDE 
 

 1. Take the envelope with the swapped content and return labels and place it in a red Canada Post box, or at the post office.
 

 2. *IMPORTANT* : To notify us that your return has been made and to help us close the file, it would be appreciated if you could send us photos of the return (e.g., photos of the package in front of a red mailbox, or at the post office).
 

 That's it, as simple as that! We trust our customers, which is why we send the new pair quickly before receiving the first one. To honor this courtesy on our part, we do ask that you return your items as soon as possible please.
 

 We look forward to hearing from you 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Véronique 
 Customer Service 
 Lasclay
